name: ai-kit
description: General software-development-lifecycle kit: ticket → brainstorm → plan → TDD → test → debug → review → PR, 13 role agents, guard hooks, and a project-rules setup flow with a rules gate so the agent follows each workspace's own rules.

inject_rules.title: Inject ai-kit rules
inject_rules.description: Add the ai-kit general SDLC rules and project-rules status to every session, and implementation rules plus role skill sets to every subagent.

rules_gate.title: Project rules gate
rules_gate.description: Load a folder's AGENTS.md rules before the first edit there, and ask the first-run rules question once per machine.

no_comments_guard.title: No-comments guard
no_comments_guard.description: Flag code comments, doc comments and plan/ticket IDs added to code without being asked.
